abilities.name: hustle
abilities.effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

abilities.name: natural-cure
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

original-johto.flavorText: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.

hoenn.flavorText: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

updated-johto.flavorText: In a south-sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

original-unova.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

updated-unova.flavorText: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

kalos.flavorText: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Clusters of Corsola congregate in warm seas where they serve as ideal hiding places for smaller Pokémon. When the water temperature falls, this Pokémon migrates to the southern seas.

original-alola.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

updated-alola.flavorText: In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby branches on their heads.

swsh.flavorText: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.
